data.narrative:
CreateMe operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector populated by 9 peer companies (1 public, 8 private). The company's development stage remains undisclosed, as does its current valuation and total capital raised. Key private peers include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics, alongside a single public comparable (ticker: 277810.KQ).

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to CreateMe's valuation. The analysis identified 10 same-sector companies but found zero matches meeting narrow stage-alignment criteria (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier groupings). A minimum of three datapoints per cohort is required for reliable peer-median analysis; the current filtered set yields insufficient coverage. Applying an all-sector median would risk material misvaluation given the heterogeneity in Robotics & Manufacturing business models and maturity profiles.

Without applicable triangulation methods, this analysis cannot support a quantified valuation range. To enable credible peer-based valuation, CreateMe's specific stage and valuation tier must be disclosed, allowing tighter cohort definition. Alternatively, additional methods—such as revenue multiple analysis (if financial metrics are available) or discounted cash flow analysis—would require non-provided financial data. Key uncertainties remain the company's funding stage, revenue scale, and burn profile relative to the identified peer set.
